title: Liquidation follow-through
description: Whether the spot price followed the last burst of liquidations. Follow-through means the flush moved the market; none means it was absorbed.

horizon_state.label: Response state
horizon_state.description: Watching while the thirty-second window after a burst is open, followed or absorbed once it closes, idle when there has been no burst. Absorbed bursts often reverse.

burst_side.label: Burst side
burst_side.description: Whether the last burst liquidated longs or shorts. Longs being flushed pushes the price down, shorts up.

response_bps_30s.label: Spot response 30s
response_bps_30s.description: How far spot moved in the thirty seconds after the burst, in basis points. Small against a big burst means absorption.

follow_through.label: Followed through
follow_through.description: Yes when spot moved the same way as the burst by more than the threshold. No means the market took the flush in its stride.
